sections.title: SECURITY PROFILES
sections.subtitle: Choose the profile for this PC

items.title: Terminal and PowerShell
items.description: Remove them from the Win+X menu.

items.title: PC information
items.description: PC record card: OS, hardware, software. Report.

items.title: Sensitive phrases
items.description: Groups and phrases used by the sensitive document search.

items.title: Sensitive documents
items.description: Find files that contain the configured phrases.

items.title: Reset policies
items.description: Reset policies and services to Windows defaults.
items.confirmText: WARNING: all applied security policies, AppLocker rules and service settings will be reset to Windows defaults.

items.title: USB history cleanup
items.description: Old USB drives and ghost volumes.
items.confirmText: Only traces of OLD devices will be removed. Drives that are connected now are detected and left untouched.

items.title: Policy audit
items.description: Compare the PC with a profile's GPO backup.

items.title: Allow to run (audit)
items.description: Add this program to the SRP/AppLocker exceptions so it can run after the policies are applied.
items.confirmText: The program will be added to the SRP and AppLocker exceptions (allowed to run for auditing after the policies are applied).

items.title: Work report
items.description: Log of all actions with integrity control (SHA-256) and a Word report.

items.title: Session report
items.description: Summary of the current run: actions, time, result, operator. Word.

items.title: Integrity control
items.description: Reference snapshot of the PC and detection of drift over time. Report on the desktop.
